about: The diagram of four box buttons (Data, Model, Posterior, Decision) joined by three arrows, the panel of the open box (key box), and the two-unit chain under them. The diagram's expectations are structural strings, as in v1: the open box's accessible name and panel title, who makes the box and the arrow labels (postrank reads a supplied posterior and does not create it), and the diagram's text alternative. The box selector names the box buttons (.prx-pp-box), because the preset row has pressed buttons too. The chain's numbers are checked against base-R oracle rows at two settings: two units of the simulated league (U13 as A and U05 as B, the frozen draw of seed 20261030, prior SD .15), whose posterior and direction probability the league's oracle rows hold, and two equal units at τ .50, where the three actions tie.

expect.value: Four boxes joined by three arrows, in order: Data (Y), Model (a prior for the true values), Posterior (the posterior of the true values given Y) and Decision (grades). Press a box to open its explanation below the boxes. The first two arrows, choosing and fitting the model and computing the posterior, are the analyst's work, done outside postrank and before it; postrank computes only the third arrow: it reads the posterior and makes the grades. A dashed frame holds the two boxes postrank touches.

cases.about: Two units of the simulated league as A and B: U13 (estimate .191004517681948, SE .2) and U05 (estimate −.375548649368271, SE .1) of the frozen draw (seed 20261030), prior SD .15. Their posterior means, SDs and kept shares are elements 12 and 4 of the league's normalPosterior oracle row, and π is the overlapping pair with the largest direction probability in the league's interval-overlap oracle row (U13 over U05).
